description: For appliance installation, this estimate worksheet records connection requirements, code-listed parts, protection, leveling, anchoring, testing, haul-away, and customer orientation. Its supporting evidence includes delivery condition, fit measurements, connection photos, leak or electrical test, serial record, and operation check.

use_case: Use the estimate worksheet during residential appliance delivery and installation when the appliance installation record must identify appliance model, serial, location, dimensions, path, utilities, cabinetry, ventilation, and old-unit disposition. Complete the applicable handoff for installed condition, function verification, customer demonstration, warranty registration, debris removal, and signoff.
